project_type: Python FastAPI app serving static HTML/JS frontend (offline-first LAN station)
build_system: No build step - plain HTML/JS/CSS served via FastAPI StaticFiles. Tailwind CDN for CSS, Chart.js CDN for graphs.
test_framework: pytest with httpx for API tests in tests/ directory
build_command: No build needed - static files served directly
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest to ensure existing tests pass. 2. Verify new HTML pages exist and have proper structure. 3. Verify new API endpoints respond correctly. 4. Check that multi-page navigation works (shared components referenced correctly).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages from PyPI. Must use pre-installed Python and already-available dependencies. CDN references (Tailwind, Chart.js) are fine since they load in browser at runtime on user machines, not during build. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: Validation rules from lazeims-common. Never re-implement them. Sessions via itsdangerous cookies. Argon2 password hashing.
key_patterns: 1. FastAPI serves index.html at '/' via FileResponse, static files at '/static/'. 2. JS modules in station/static/js/ with state.js as shared mutable state. 3. api.js provides fetch wrappers ($, api, jpost, jput, jdel, esc, fmt, pct). 4. Views are <section> elements toggled by router.js showView(). 5. DB is SQLite with WAL mode. 6. user_scopes table: assignment_id + centre_number + subject_code. 7. All existing entry logic (marks, attendance, finalize) works well and must be preserved.
directory_structure: station/ - main Python package (main.py, auth.py, db.py, entry.py, finalize.py, etc). station/static/ - HTML/CSS/JS frontend. station/static/js/ - modular ES6 JS files. tests/ - pytest tests.
